content: {"doneWhen":{"all":[{"path":"body.x","op":"eq","value":11},{"path":"body.y","op":"eq","value":1}]},"modes":[{"id":"flee","priority":20,"when":{"all":[{"path":"nearest(monster).dist","op":"lte","value":2}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"flee"}},{"id":"navigate","priority":10,"when":{"all":[{"path":"body.x","op":"gte","value":0}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"field-work"}}],"skills":[{"name":"field-work","skill":"async (b) => { const r = await b.walkTo(11, 1, 'stand'); b.log('walkTo ladder: ' + JSON.stringify(r)); return r; }","check":"async (b) => { const p = await b.body(); return {ok: p.x === 11 && p.y === 1, detail: 'at ' + p.x + ',' + p.y}; }"},{"name":"flee","skill":"async (b) => { const ms = await b.monsters(); const p = await b.body(); if (!ms.length) return {ok:true}; const m = ms[0]; const dx = p.x - m.x, dy = p.y - m.y; const tx = Math.max(0, Math.min(12, p.x + (dx>=0?1:-1))); const ty = Math.max(0, Math.min(9, p.y + (dy>=0?1:-1))); const r = await b.walkTo(tx, ty, 'stand'); b.log('flee: ' + JSON.stringify(r)); return r; }","check":"async (b) => { const ms = await b.monsters(); return {ok: !ms.length || ms[0].dist > 2, detail: 'monsters: ' + ms.length}; }"}]}
